  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The blocks-path filter excludes skip-warning notices with the prefix `"merged-PR guard skipped: "`, so they are omitted when another target blocks.
  WHY: For a multi-target push with one blocked target and another that produces a skip warning, the operator sees only the block reason and loses the skip diagnostic.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:529-542 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Bulk push modes `--all` and `--mirror` are treated as ordinary options, so without an explicit refspec the parser checks only the current branch.
  WHY: `git push --all origin` pushes every local branch, and `--mirror` writes refs beyond the checked-out branch; a stale local branch with merged-PR history can therefore be pushed without being examined.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:534-542 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `--tags` is treated as an ordinary option, so a tag-only push without an explicit refspec is judged against the current branch.
  WHY: `git push --tags origin` pushes tags, not the checked-out branch, so the guard can block or prompt for an operation that does not write to that branch.
